description: This file defines the NotesListScreen widget, which displays a list of notes, allows creating, editing, and deleting notes within a Flutter application. It manages the UI and interactions for note listing, including delete confirmations and navigation to the note editor.

classes.name: NotesListScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying the list of notes, supporting addition, editing, and deletion of notes.

classes.name: _NotesListScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the logic and UI for NotesListScreen, including initialization, formatting, and user interactions.

classes.name: _EmptyState
classes.description: A stateless widget shown when there are no notes, prompting the user to create a new note.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the provider when the widget is created, ensuring notes are loaded.

methods.name: _formatTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp in milliseconds to a human-readable date-time string.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for deleting a note, and performs deletion if confirmed.

methods.name: _openEditor
methods.description: Navigates to the note editor screen, optionally passing an existing note.
